regions.merged_text: Many Thanks for your kind remembrance. May the Divine Master of the mission- aries bless you and yours! And may you hear His call Today from the tabernacle and from the Crib - as His first Twelve harken- ed to His plea at the well of Jacob:". Pray ye therefore, the Lord of the harvest that He send laborers into His harvest."
